method: src/pgwr/install-to-card.sh; autodetected card, automatic backup, .new staging, cmp/diff verification
manifest: builds/pgwr/0.20.3/ (no MANIFEST.json; the mod tree is byte-identical to 0.20.0's, only the NRO differs)
mod_tree_note: Unchanged since 0.20.0. Both changes are Rust-only, so the 0.20.0 tree was reused rather than regenerated; its hash was recomputed and equals the card's, so no asset differs.
changes: New module diddy_probe.rs: read-only observation of STOCK Diddy, the donor, so Monkey Flip has a control for the first time. Installs ONE additive on_line(Main) callback and no status or acmd scripts, so none of Diddy's own scripts, clips, hitboxes, damage or motion are replaced - he stays a valid vanilla control. Logs his own SPECIAL_S Monkey Flip block (0x1E5-0x1EF in his table, never equated with ours per AGENTS.md rule 19) and CLUNG_DIDDY, one line per status change plus a bounded per-frame window.

Monkey Flip VICTIM lines gained near=/ndtop=: the nearest active fighter found by scanning the battle object id range, independent of whether the engine published a capture. This is the measurement that was missing: in the 0.20.2 run all 26 VICTIM frames read dist=-1.00 dtop=-1.00 because no victim object existed, so the log could not say whether the box contained an opponent.
not_a_behaviour_change: No state is written by either change. The nearest-opponent scan only reads module accessors, guards every id with sv_battle_object::is_active, re-checks the accessor for null and identity, and filters to BATTLE_OBJECT_CATEGORY_FIGHTER so no article or projectile is touched or cast (AGENTS.md rules 19 and 25).
